title: Six And Out Over The Fence (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Now son, the backyard rule.
You go over Mrs Hendersons fence
You are OUT
AND you go get the ball

[Verse 1]
Straight boundary is the Hills Hoist line
Over the fence to the left, six AND you are out of time
The taped-up tennis ball flies high
Over Mrs Hendersons roses, goodbye

Six and out, that is the backyard law
Carved it in concrete, ask my father before
Hit to leg side, bonus two runs scored
Hit the wheelie bin, quadruple reward

[Pre-Chorus]
Six and out over the fence you go
You go get the ball from the garden though
Six runs credited to your tally
Then you are walking, no dawdling in the alley

[Chorus]
Six and out over the fence
Six runs scored but your innings ends
The backyard rule keeps the big hits fair
Six and out, every backyard shares

[Verse 2]
Over the shed roof on the full, five runs
Over the car in the driveway, your innings still runs
But clear the back fence to the neighbours lawn
You are six and out, and retrieval is sworn

[Bridge]
Bluey: He has cleared the back fence, SIX AND OUT, what a tremendous blow
Trevor: Statistically that is the highest risk shot in backyard cricket, six but wicket lost
Chas: AND MY BALL SON. My ball. Two dollars that ball.

[Chorus]
Six and out over the fence
Six runs scored but your innings ends
The backyard rule keeps the big hits fair
Six and out, every backyard shares

[Outro]
Go get it
And apologize to Mrs Henderson
Thats my boy
